text: Assumption: The enumeration value DONOTCARE serves as an identifier indicating that a Core does not configure its own mode, but adopts it — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The enumeration value DONOTCARE serves as an identifier indicating that a Core does not configure its own mode, but adopts it — is this correct?
norm: the enumeration value donotcare serves as an identifier indicating that a core does not configure its own mode but adopts it
assumption: The enumeration value DONOTCARE serves as an identifier indicating that a Core does not configure its own mode, but adopts it.
rationale: SWS_Os_91007 specifies DONOTCARE as the only range of values and describes the inheritance of the app mode from another Core.

original.text: Annahme: Der Enumerationswert DONOTCARE dient als Kennung dafür, dass ein Core keinen eigenen Modus konfiguriert, sondern diesen übernimmt — trifft das zu?
